pages.title: Euclidean Shard
pages.text: A splinter of perfectly straight line: Euclid's first postulate, that between any two points a straight line can be drawn, made solid. Found in Euclidean Ore in the Elements, the Platonic Realm's marble layer (Y 320 to 400), and dropped by Euclid's Automaton.

$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Euclidean Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Euclid's Automaton.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Geometers Ruin chests.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Euclidean Marble, Golden Ratio Glass, Governor, Optimised Pathway, Pattern Basin, Strategy Table.
